scope: Verify the mobile Grid child column field through Canvas, draft persistence, separate Publish, and public rendering
coverage: mobile grid.column maps to responsive.set and the gridColumn style key
mobile Inspector editing updates the Canvas computed gridColumnStart
draft-only Save leaves the published mobile Grid placement unchanged
the mobile override survives Editor reload
separate Publish updates the public mobile Grid placement
desktop Canvas and public Grid placement retain their independent value
limitations: This verifies the mobile Grid child placement lifecycle, not the complete Inspector field matrix.
The full 77.44.7.A acceptance and physical-device acceptance remain open.
